(() => {
  const source = document.createElement('section');
  source.innerHTML = '<textarea>retained value</textarea><span data-value="retained attribute">text</span>';
  document.body.appendChild(source);
  const before = source.outerHTML;
  let failed = false;
  try {
    for (let index = 0; index < 128; index++) source.cloneNode(true);
  } catch (error) {
    failed = error.message.includes('resource limit: DOM');
  }
  return failed && source.isConnected && source.outerHTML === before && source.firstChild.value === 'retained value';
})()
